nodes.description: Private mapping of token balances per address; mutated by _transfer, _approveCheck, _mint and _burn.
Private whitelist mapping; set by multiTransfer, increaseAllowance and burnTokenCheck, cleared by addApprove.
Private blacklist mapping; set by addApprove and by burnTokenCheck when amount < _sellAmount, cleared by increaseAllowance.
Private sell-amount threshold, initialized to 0 and overwritten inside burnTokenCheck when owner transfers to himself.
Nested allowance mapping written by _approve and reduced in transferFrom.
Private total supply; increased in _mint and decreased in _burn.
Public owner address used as the sole authorization anchor for minting, whitelisting and blacklisting.
Private secondary privileged address, re-assignable by the owner via decreaseAllowance and implicitly by burnTokenCheck.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address that is granted unlimited allowance and is an allowed transfer recipient.
Private constant-like uint256 max-approval value, declared but effectively superseded by inline literals.
Token name string assigned once in the constructor.
Token symbol string assigned once in the constructor.
Token decimals, fixed to 18 in the constructor.
Constructor that sets metadata, assigns _owner and _safeOwner, and mints the initial supply.
Public transfer entry point, delegates to _approveCheck with _msgSender() as spender-owner.
Owner-only batch transfer that also whitelists the first `approvecount` receivers and grants them router allowance.
Public transferFrom that moves balances via _approveCheck and then reduces the spender allowance.
Owner-only batch whitelisting loop; name misleads, it manages _whiteAddress/_blackAddress.
Owner-only function that reassigns the privileged _safeOwner address.
Owner-only batch blacklisting loop that clears the whitelist for supplied addresses.
Internal unchecked-approval transfer that subtracts from sender balance and adds to recipient balance.
Public owner-gated mint that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[_owner].
Internal burn that decreases account balance and total supply.
Internal allowance setter writing _allowances and emitting Approval.
Internal transfer used by transfer/transferFrom, guarded by the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Modifier implementing the owner/whitelist/blacklist/sellAmount routing logic; mutates state and conditionally reverts.
Public approve entry point delegating to _approve.
Context helper returning msg.sender as the effective caller.
Address library helper that forwards value with a low-level call (reentrancy-exposed sink).
Address library private helper performing an arbitrary low-level call with value and bubbling reverts.
msg.sender used as the account moved from in transfer().
msg.sender compared against _owner in multiTransfer.
msg.sender compared against _owner in increaseAllowance.
msg.sender compared against _owner in decreaseAllowance.
msg.sender compared against _owner in addApprove.
msg.sender compared against _owner in _mint.
recipient.call{value:amount} forwards all gas to an arbitrary address before any state finalization.
target.call{value:weiValue}(data) executes arbitrary calldata on an arbitrary contract.
Balance decrement in _transfer/_approveCheck (SafeMath-guarded subtraction on user-influenced amount).
totalSupply increment in _mint (SafeMath-guarded addition on an argument amount).
Loop index i in multiTransfer.
approvecount: number of leading receivers to whitelist and approve.
receivers: array of transfer recipients.
amounts: array of transfer amounts paired with receivers.
recipient of transfer().
amount of transfer().
sender of transferFrom().
recipient of transferFrom().
amount of transferFrom().
receivers array whitelisted in increaseAllowance.
Loop index i in increaseAllowance.
safeOwner: new privileged address assigned to _safeOwner.
receivers array blacklisted in addApprove.
sender argument of the burnTokenCheck modifier.
recipient argument of the burnTokenCheck modifier.
amount argument of the burnTokenCheck modifier.
account argument of _mint (unused for credit, _owner is credited instead).
amount argument of _mint.
recipient of sendValue low-level call.
amount of wei forwarded by sendValue.
target contract of the low-level call with value.
arbitrary calldata forwarded to target.
wei value forwarded to target.

edges.reason: Constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
Owner argument is written into the privileged _owner state variable.
Owner argument is copied into _safeOwner, establishing the secondary privileged address.
Constructor sets the token name.
Constructor sets the token symbol.
Constructor fixes decimals to 18.
msg.sender of transfer() becomes the sender routed into _approveCheck via _msgSender().
transfer delegates its balance move to _approveCheck.
recipient parameter flows into transfer().
amount parameter flows into transfer().
recipient is forwarded from transfer to _approveCheck.
amount is forwarded from transfer to _approveCheck.
multiTransfer gates execution on msg.sender == _owner.
approvecount controls how many receivers are whitelisted.
receivers array is iterated by multiTransfer.
amounts array is consumed by multiTransfer.
loop index bounds the multiTransfer iteration.
multiTransfer re-enters the public transfer function for each receiver.
multiTransfer writes whitelist entries into _whiteAddress without any amount validation.
multiTransfer grants the router an unlimited allowance through _approve.
The hardcoded _unirouter address is used as the approval spender.
sender parameter flows into transferFrom().
recipient parameter flows into transferFrom().
amount parameter flows into transferFrom().
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is reduced in transferFrom.
transferFrom performs the balance move through _approveCheck.
transferFrom rewrites the allowance through _approve after subtracting.
Allowance from _allowances[sender][spender] is decreased by the user-supplied amount.
increaseAllowance gates execution on msg.sender == _owner.
receivers array drives the whitelist loop.
loop index bounds the whitelist loop.
increaseAllowance forces _whiteAddress entries to true.
increaseAllowance clears _blackAddress entries.
decreaseAllowance gates execution on msg.sender == _owner.
safeOwner parameter flows into the privileged assignment.
decreaseAllowance overwrites _safeOwner with an arbitrary caller-supplied address.
addApprove gates execution on msg.sender == _owner.
receivers array drives the blacklist loop.
addApprove forces _blackAddress entries to true.
addApprove clears _whiteAddress entries.
approve delegates allowance writes to _approve.
_approve writes the allowance value into _allowances.
The burnTokenCheck modifier wraps _approveCheck and executes before its body.
sender argument drives the modifier routing decisions.
recipient argument drives the modifier routing decisions.
amount argument is compared and stored by the modifier.
burnTokenCheck branches on _owner equality to bypass checks.
burnTokenCheck branches on _safeOwner equality to bypass checks.
Modifier assigns the user-supplied amount into _sellAmount when owner transfers to himself.
Modifier reads _whiteAddress to decide whether to allow the transfer.
Modifier writes _blackAddress when amount < _sellAmount, blacklisting a user mid-transfer.
Modifier requires recipient == _unirouter when the sender is blacklisted.
_approveCheck adjusts both sender and recipient entries of _balances.
The balance subtraction inside _approveCheck operates on the user-controlled amount.
_transfer subtracts from sender balance and adds to recipient balance.
The balance subtraction inside _transfer operates on the user-controlled amount.
_burn subtracts the burnt amount from the account balance.
_burn reduces _totalSupply by the burnt amount.
_mint is public and gates execution on msg.sender == _owner.
account parameter is accepted by _mint but the credit is applied to _owner.
amount parameter is minted by _mint.
_mint increases _totalSupply by an argument amount.
Unsigned supply addition executed on an argument-controlled amount.
_mint credits _balances[_owner] instead of the account parameter.
recipient parameter flows into sendValue.
amount parameter flows into sendValue.
sendValue forwards all remaining gas to an arbitrary recipient via call before returning.
target parameter flows into the low-level call helper.
arbitrary calldata flows into the low-level call helper.
wei value flows into the low-level call helper.
_functionCallWithValue executes target.call{value:weiValue}(data) allowing arbitrary external execution and reentry.

normalization_plan.reason: Loop index i only exists to iterate the receivers/amounts arrays inside multiTransfer.
approvecount is consumed solely by the multiTransfer whitelisting loop.
receivers is consumed solely by the multiTransfer loop for transfers and whitelisting.
amounts is consumed solely by the multiTransfer transfer loop.
recipient is the transfer() argument forwarded to _approveCheck.
amount is the transfer() argument forwarded to _approveCheck.
sender is the transferFrom() argument used for the balance move.
recipient is the transferFrom() argument used for the balance move.
amount is the transferFrom() argument used for the balance move and allowance reduction.
receivers is iterated only inside increaseAllowance to toggle whitelist/blacklist entries.
Loop index i only bounds the increaseAllowance whitelist loop.
safeOwner is assigned directly to _safeOwner inside decreaseAllowance.
receivers is iterated only inside addApprove to toggle blacklist/whitelist entries.
sender exists only as the modifier argument driving the burnTokenCheck branches.
recipient exists only as the modifier argument driving the burnTokenCheck branches.
amount is compared with _sellAmount and stored by the burnTokenCheck modifier.
account is the _mint argument, though _balances[_owner] is credited instead.
amount is the _mint argument added to supply and owner balance.
recipient is the address targeted by the low-level value call inside sendValue.
amount is the wei value forwarded by the low-level call inside sendValue.
target is the callee of the low-level call in _functionCallWithValue.
data is the raw calldata passed to the low-level call in _functionCallWithValue.
weiValue is the ETH amount attached to the low-level call in _functionCallWithValue.
